text:
Brittany Pettersen criticizes House GOP actions and Trump proposals in July Twitter posts
M. B. Fisher
U.S. Rep. Brittany Pettersen, who represents Colorado’s 7th district in Congress, posted a series of statements on her Twitter account between July 21 and July 22, 2026, criticizing recent actions by House Republicans and former President Donald Trump.
The following morning, she commented on recent legislative activity: "Last night, House Republicans passed a CR, funding the government only through December 4th, conveniently after the November election. That's not governing; that's kicking the can down the road so they don't have to answer for their choices.
Coloradans deserve a functioning" (July 22).
Later that day, Pettersen addressed military spending: "House Republicans just chose Trump’s illegal war over American families. They voted to pour another $73 billion into the war with Iran while the rest of us foot the bill. They're making America less safe and everyday life has never been harder. It’s shameful. https://t.co/S6HvDTydrV" (July 22).
Pettersen has represented Colorado's 7th District in Congress since replacing Ed Perlmutter in 2023 and previously served in both chambers of Colorado's state legislature from 2013 to 2023. She was born in Colorado in 1981 and resides in Lakewood. Pettersen holds a BA from Metropolitan State University of Denver.
